title: DX SDKs & Samples Lab retro — May 28 2026
content:
Context: quick retro/check-in for the Samples Lab and SDK surface. Goal: reconcile the last two weeks of work, decide priorities for the next iteration (inc. 1.2.0 quickstarts), and capture action items for docs + sample stability improvements. Rough, partially transcribed — notes to self + squad.

Date: 2026-05-28 10:00–11:00 PT
Attendees: Maya Chen (owner), Luis Ortega, Priya Nair, Ben Jacobs, Zoe Patel, Arjun Mehta; joined late: Samira (platform eng) for 15m.
"Notes and highlights:
- Quickstarts playbook: ran through the JS + Python quickstarts end-to-end. Observations: authentication snippets still confusing for first-time users; OIDC snippet in the console doc diverges from SDK code samples (discrepancy noted).
- New sample: "todo-saas-kvcache" (experimental) — demonstrates prefix caching + small 2-step prompt with streaming. Worked locally but flaky in CI (mac runners hang on server start).
- SDK parity: feature parity looks close but docs call out `client.generate()` in JS vs `client.completion()` in Py. We need canonical API naming before 1.2.0 release.
- Telemetry and examples: sample apps should include minimal telemetry hooks (events: start, success, fallback) and show how to pipe traces into Redwood Console. Current samples lack instrumentation examples.
- Docs: quickstart page length increased by 40% due to extra auth troubleshooting. We discussed moving advanced auth to an "Appendix: auth flows" doc to shorten the main quickstart.
- DevDX checklist items that keep recurring: (1) single command to run sample (e.g., `make demo` or `pnpm start`), (2) CI assert that README quickstart steps actually work (automated smoke test), (3) include token scoping example for limited keys.

Decisions: (voting summary)
- Freeze API naming for 1.2.0: adopt `client.generate()` as canonical surface across JS + Py (2:1 vote with a follow-up engineering note to alias `completion()` to `generate()` for backwards compatibility). Owner: Maya. Deadline: 2026-06-08.
- Quickstarts will move advanced auth into an "Auth Appendix" and keep landing page to a single-page quick path (create key -> run demo). Owner: Priya. Deadline: 2026-06-04.
- Samples Lab CI: create a lightweight smoke harness that runs the sample's `demo` and looks for common stdout markers within 30s. Use a dedicated CI job label `samples-smoke`. Owner: Ben. Deadline: 2026-06-11.

Action items (concrete):
- Maya: open umbrella PR to add `generate()` alias in py-sdk and js-sdk, document deprecation plan for `completion()`. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood-py-sdk/pull/198 (WIP). Due: 2026-06-08.
- Priya: restructure quickstart pages: main quickstart -> 4 steps, separate advanced auth appendix. Update console snippets to match SDKs. Due: 2026-06-04.
- Ben: implement `samples-smoke` CI job; ensure it runs on linux+mac runners and retries on flake. Add simple fixture for `todo-saas-kvcache`. Due: 2026-06-11.
- Zoe: add telemetry examples to 2 sample apps (JS + Py) and include Console trace wiring notes. Small PRs per sample. Due: 2026-06-09.
- Arjun: investigate macOS CI hang root cause (likely port collision / firewall quirks). Collect logs from failing runs and escalate to infra. Jira ticket RDW-1423 assigned to Arjun. Due: 2026-06-03.
- Luis: groom Samples Lab backlog, prioritize top 5 samples for onboarding funnel (todo-saas-kvcache, embed-search-demo, chatops-agent, csv-reranker, image-captioner). Schedule pairing sessions to rewrite README for the top 3. Due: 2026-06-07.

Open questions / blockers:
- NPM signing: legal asked for guidance on package signing for published `@redwood-inference/*` packages. Who owns the org process? (Assign legal/infra touchpoint).
- Versioning: If we ship generate() alias, how long do we keep the old name? Need a deprecation timeline and announcements. ACTION: Maya to draft a 3-release deprecation plan.
- Sample CI cost: running full sample suite on every push is expensive. Proposal: smoke on PRs, nightly full-run. Need SRE input for capacity.

Small notes / fragments recorded during meeting (scrappy):
- "Make demos one-liners" — consensus that `pnpm i && pnpm demo` is ideal; `docker-compose` alternative for offline dev.
- Prefix caching sample: show before/after token cost (include token counts and cost delta) — very convincing for product folks.
- Quick idea: add a chrome extension in samples repo that shows latency/cost overlay for the demo UI. Nice but backlog.
- UX nit: code snippets in quickstart have inconsistent copy buttons on mobile. Filed small issue in docs repo.

Notes on PRs & artifacts we referenced:
- js-sdk PR (auth snippet sync): https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood-js-sdk/pull/412 — contains sample auth helper (`useRedwoodAuth`) and node example. Needs docs sync.
- py-sdk alias PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood-py-sdk/pull/198 — adds `generate()` wrapper and test matrix update (py3.9–3.11).
- Jira: RDW-1423 (samples CI mac hang) — logs attached; assigned to Arjun.
- Confluence: Samples Lab Index — canonical list of sample apps + owner matrix. Update requested by Luis.

Post-meeting priorities (next 2 sprints):
- Sprint A (now->2026-06-11): implement `generate()` aliases; restructure quickstarts; CI smoke job (linux priority); telemetry snippets added to top samples; triage mac CI.
- Sprint B (2026-06-12->2026-06-25): full samples CI nightly; sample-run cost reporting; add smoke tests to PR templates; draft deprecation notice for `completion()`.

Follow-ups / who to loop in:
- SRE: cost+CI capacity — loop Jack (sre) and Samira for CI runner quotas.
- Legal: NPM signing policy — loop Priya (GTM) to triage and create a legal intake.
- Console eng: short doc on how to wire traces from sample apps into Console (Zoe to pair with Console eng).

Retro takeaways (one-liners):
- Keep quickstarts minimal; push advanced auth + edge cases to appendices.
- Smoke tests + one-command demos are highest ROI for first-time users.
- Parity across SDKs wins trust — canonical naming + small compatibility aliases smoother than breaking changes.

Next meeting: weekly samples standup on Fridays 10:00 PT. Next sync: 2026-06-04 (quick check of progress on action items).

TODOs (short):
- [ ] Maya: PR aliases — ensure tests green.
- [ ] Priya: Quickstart restructure + console snippet sync.
- [ ] Ben: samples-smoke CI.
- [ ] Zoe: telemetry examples.
- [ ] Arjun: CI mac investigation.
- [ ] Luis: backlog grooming + owner sync.

(End of notes)
